strongest_angle: Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of an all-out invasion in the northern Tigray region, prompting letters to the UN Security Council and raising fears of renewed regional war.

key_facts.fact: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of launching an all-out invasion into the northern Tigray region and sent a letter to the UN Security Council warning it will defend itself.
UN Secretary-General António Guterres expressed grave concern over renewed fighting in northern Ethiopia and reports of Eritrean forces present in the country.
Eritrea asked the United Nations to take deterrent measures after describing Ethiopia's actions as a declaration of war in the Tigray region conflict.
Ethiopian military vehicles and troops entered Adigrat near the Eritrean border on Saturday while residents celebrated.
